steps.js: (async () => { const jp = async (...parts) => { const r = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw('app.joinPath', ...parts); return r.value; }; const inv = async (method, ...args) => { const r = await window.gitgoodBridge.invokeRaw(method, ...args); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error.message); return r.value; }; await window.__gitgood.actions.updateSettings({ theme: 'light' }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const exportPath = await jp(__REPO_PATH__, 'gitgood-settings-export.json'); await inv('settings.exportToFile', exportPath, ['preferences']); const text = await inv('repo.readFile', __REPO_PATH__, 'gitgood-settings-export.json'); const parsed = JSON.parse(text); const forbidden = ['hasApiKey', 'claudeCliPath', 'gitPath', 'ghPath', 'gistId', '"window"'].some((k) => text.includes(k)); await window.__gitgood.actions.updateSettings({ theme: 'dark' }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const themeBeforeImport = window.__gitgood.store.get().settings.theme; await inv('settings.import', exportPath, 'merge', ['preferences']); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const themeAfterImport = window.__gitgood.store.get().settings.theme; return JSON.stringify({ hasSchema: parsed.schema === 1, hasApp: parsed.app === 'gitgood', hasPreferencesTheme: parsed.preferences && parsed.preferences.theme === 'light', containsForbidden: forbidden, themeBeforeImport, themeAfterImport }); })()
